topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this is happening. My car, just sitting there, where I always put it, right in my own driveway. Now it's gone. Just like that. They took it without a word, without a chance to explain. I was at work, thinking everything was fine, and now I come home, and it's like it was never there. I don't know what to do. I need that car. I can't afford this, can't afford to lose it. The signs didn't say anything about towing. I've lived here for years, and this has never happened. Where do I even start to find it, to get it back? This can't be real.
